phases.title: Reproducible foundation
phases.gate: Synthetic core, ABI, bridge math, manifests, and Windows builds are reproducible without source-fidelity claims.

phases.title: Owner-data extraction
phases.gate: Owner inputs import safely, validate, and produce one stable source fingerprint.

phases.title: Dual-perspective colossal-sword slice
phases.gate: All melee release assertions pass in first- and third-person under CrossOver.

phases.title: Action and armament balance
phases.gate: Every action role and armament bonus stays inside tested envelopes and the 1.15x cap.

phases.title: Elements, statuses, modifiers, affinities
phases.gate: One delivery-neutral path resolves independent consequence channels through Skyrim authority.

phases.title: Poise, stance, ripostes
phases.gate: Interruption, stance breaks, hyperarmour, and earned killmoves remain distinct.

phases.title: Bow and arrow delivery
phases.gate: One longbow and physical, elemental, and buildup arrows pass under CrossOver.

phases.title: Smithing stones and gear quality
phases.gate: Weapons and catalysts share a bounded upgrade axis with no eligibility requirements.

phases.title: Catalysts
phases.gate: Staff and ring catalysts dedicate hands correctly and create distinct builds through passives.

phases.title: Magic delivery
phases.gate: The seven-case spell matrix composes proven action, projectile, effect, and catalyst systems.

phases.title: Enemy rule symmetry
phases.gate: NPC attacks are committed, readable, and governed by shared stamina, posture, and effects.

phases.title: Breadth and compatibility
phases.gate: Additional content, saves, and the target modlist pass a documented ownership matrix.

phases.title: Torrent
phases.gate: Summoning, traversal, health, double jump, immunity, and mounted attacks work under CrossOver.

phases.title: Encounters and megafauna
phases.gate: Priority encounters use proven rules; creature-heavy megafauna remains last.

phases.title: Combat-platform release
phases.gate: The complete combat platform ships with exact-commit CrossOver evidence and no proprietary files.

phases.title: Megafauna, last
phases.gate: Creature work begins only after the combat platform is already releasable.

phases.title: Zero-to-hero release
phases.gate: The optional final creature work and the complete regression both pass without changing established combat.

tasks.title: Finish the versioned engine-neutral combat IR

subtasks.work: Define versioned action, window, motion, sweep, provenance, and ranged-extension records without absolute Elden Ring damage.
subtasks.done_when: Malformed windows, units, provenance, and forbidden damage fields fail by name.

subtasks.work: Add positive and negative golden fixtures for melee, dodge, charge, and projectile release records.
subtasks.done_when: Valid fixtures round-trip and each invalid fixture has one expected failure.

subtasks.work: Make unsupported IR versions fail and document explicit migrations.
subtasks.done_when: Generated owner data can never be silently reinterpreted.

tasks.done_when: The IR validates engine-neutral facts and provenance while refusing source-game absolute damage.

tasks.title: Record and replay deterministic combat traces

subtasks.work: Define tick-based input, world, action, motion, contact, stamina, consequence, and presentation-observation events.
subtasks.done_when: Every event has stable identity and ordering without wall-clock dependence.

subtasks.work: Implement headless replay and canonical serialization.
subtasks.done_when: Repeated runs are byte-identical.

subtasks.work: Prove perspective markers cannot alter core output.
subtasks.done_when: Action, motion, i-frame, stamina, and contact bytes remain identical.

tasks.done_when: Synthetic combat traces replay byte-for-byte and presentation events are mechanically inert.

tasks.title: Pin macOS, Windows, ABI, and package builds

subtasks.done_when: Any ABI drift fails before packaging.

subtasks.work: Pin Rust, MSVC, CommonLib, CMake, Ninja, and vcpkg inputs.
subtasks.done_when: A clean Windows runner produces both synthetic DLLs.

subtasks.work: Stage the mod from explicit inputs while excluding owner data, generated animations/audio, logs, and secrets.
subtasks.done_when: The artifact inventory contains no forbidden files.

tasks.done_when: Local and Windows builds are reproducible and packaging is proprietary-data safe.

subtasks.done_when: The ignored manifest rejects placeholders and missing fields.

subtasks.work: Reject evidence for another commit, source table, artifact, log, or acceptance key.
subtasks.done_when: Every stale dimension has a regression test.

tasks.done_when: Release evidence is exact-commit and cannot be manufactured from host tests.

subtasks.done_when: Any byte change changes the source fingerprint.

subtasks.work: Validate before atomically installing generated outputs only under ignored owner-data paths.

tasks.done_when: The owner bundle imports safely and the source profile names its exact fingerprint.

subtasks.work: Replay the owner table while preserving its source-only claim ceiling.
subtasks.done_when: Source traces pass and remain distinguishable from synthetic estimates.

tasks.done_when: The source profile passes with no estimated colossal-sword facts.

tasks.done_when: Owner-generated first- and third-person presentations validate in Skyrim and remain untracked.

subtasks.work: Read correct camera heading in both perspectives without exposing perspective to the core.

tasks.done_when: Required Skyrim facts cross the ABI deterministically and perspective-independently.

tasks.title: Apply root-motion intent through Skyrim collision

subtasks.work: Convert desired position into bounded character-controller requests; never teleport.
subtasks.done_when: Clamp, invalid-value, grounded, airborne, and heading tests pass.

subtasks.work: Read collision-resolved position on the next tick and feed it back to the core.
subtasks.done_when: Walls, slopes, steps, and doorways cause no accumulated drift.

subtasks.work: Capture walk, sprint, roll, and attack motion against representative collision cases.
subtasks.done_when: Runtime evidence shows no tunnelling or teleporting.

tasks.done_when: Elden Ring motion intent survives Skyrim collision and actual Skyrim position remains authoritative.

tasks.title: Submit and reconcile Skyrim-native melee hits

subtasks.work: Keep sweep contact as a deterministic observation with stable action/target identity.
subtasks.done_when: Selection is order-independent and stale/duplicate observations fail.

subtasks.work: Submit the equipped weapon's normal Skyrim hit path through a narrow gateway.
subtasks.done_when: Skyrim perks, armour, difficulty, gore, and attribution remain active.

subtasks.work: Confirm core contact only after the matching successful native submission, once.
subtasks.done_when: Misses, mismatches, projectiles, stale events, and duplicates cannot confirm.

tasks.done_when: One live sweep yields one matching Skyrim-native hit and one core confirmation.

tasks.title: Integrate incoming defense and Skyrim stamina

subtasks.work: Classify incoming native contact once as dodged, jumped, blocked, guard-broken, or landed.
subtasks.done_when: Only landed contact reaches damage and every result logs once.

subtasks.work: Let the core schedule costs while Skyrim owns pool, maximum, regeneration, perks, and saves.
subtasks.done_when: Exhaustion is deterministic and no parallel saved pool exists.

subtasks.work: Resolve direction, guard cost, break, and animation through a narrow adapter.
subtasks.done_when: Guard keeps Skyrim equipment/perks and core timing.

tasks.done_when: Incoming contact and stamina resolve authoritatively without duplicate damage or spend.

tasks.title: Apply local hit-stop and structured runtime logging

subtasks.work: Freeze bounded attacker/target presentation and combat stepping without globally pausing Skyrim.
subtasks.done_when: Overlap, menu, kill, and chained-hit rules are deterministic.

subtasks.work: Log action, motion, contact, stamina, defense, hit-stop, and perspective events with stable IDs/ticks.
subtasks.done_when: Runtime logs compare to headless replay without pointers or wall clock.

tasks.done_when: Confirmed hits create bounded local hit-stop and a complete safe deterministic trail.

tasks.title: Synchronize first- and third-person combat presentation

subtasks.work: Drive or seek both graphs from the same action ID, serial, and frame; never restart on view change.
subtasks.done_when: Switching view reveals the same action phase.

subtasks.work: Integrate collision-aware third-person and stable-horizon first-person cameras.
subtasks.done_when: Roll, knockdown, attack, and hit-stop avoid clipping and unwanted horizon roll.

subtasks.work: Toggle during startup, live hit, recovery, charge, roll, stagger, and hit-stop.
subtasks.done_when: Serial/frame, motion, stamina, i-frames, target, buffer, and contacts remain unchanged.

tasks.done_when: Both views present one combat state and perspective changes are mechanically inert.

subtasks.done_when: Every assertion has direct captured evidence.

subtasks.work: Run paired views and mid-action switches from one starting save.
subtasks.done_when: Presentation, continuity, and timing/geometry parity pass.

subtasks.work: Bind source, artifacts, log, versions, hardware, and commit.
subtasks.done_when: Release verification passes with a clean tree.

tasks.done_when: All 14 release assertions pass on Apple Silicon CrossOver.

tasks.done_when: Balance is data-driven, capped, and calibrated against Skyrim rather than source absolutes.
